captions_note: Captions come from kimo's own speech recognition (auto_captions: beam search, a Hinglish prompt, a Hindi/Urdu/Punjabi/Marathi pass), not a hand-typed transcript -- director_mode.md's own guidance when the brief's transcript is not trustworthy (this speech is accented, informal Hinglish). 'hint' is a vocabulary/topic hint for the recognizer only; it does not change what gets written on screen. Any word the recognizer is not confident about is reported by run_demo.py (stderr + the printed JSON's captions.low_confidence_words), never silently replaced with a guess.
